Task: add ipset set-extension support to the Ansible iptables module.

diff --git a/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py b/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py
index 7326b65..3a3527f 100644
--- a/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py
+++ b/test/units/modules/test_iptables.py
@@ -953,3 +953,68 @@ class TestIptables(ModuleTestCase):
             '-m', 'comment',
             '--comment', 'this is a comment'
         ])
+
+    def test_match_set_rule(self):
+        for flags in ('src', 'dst', 'src,dst', 'dst,src'):
+            for match in ([], ['set']):
+                set_module_args({
+                    'chain': 'INPUT',
+                    'protocol': 'tcp',
+                    'match': match,
+                    'match_set': 'admin_hosts',
+                    'match_set_flags': flags,
+                    'destination_port': '22',
+                    'jump': 'ACCEPT',
+                    'comment': 'SSH access',
+                    '_ansible_check_mode': True,
+                })
+                with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command') as run_command:
+                    run_command.return_value = 1, '', ''
+                    with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson):
+                        iptables.main()
+                self.assertEqual(run_command.call_count, 1)
+                self.assertEqual(run_command.call_args[0][0], [
+                    '/sbin/iptables', '-t', 'filter', '-C', 'INPUT',
+                    '-p', 'tcp', '-m', 'set', '--match-set', 'admin_hosts', flags,
+                    '-j', 'ACCEPT', '--destination-port', '22',
+                    '-m', 'comment', '--comment', 'SSH access',
+                ])
+
+    def test_match_set_inverted(self):
+        set_module_args({
+            'chain': 'INPUT',
+            'match_set': '!admin_hosts',
+            'match_set_flags': 'src',
+            '_ansible_check_mode': True,
+        })
+        with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command') as run_command:
+            run_command.return_value = 1, '', ''
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson):
+                iptables.main()
+        self.assertEqual(run_command.call_args[0][0], [
+            '/sbin/iptables', '-t', 'filter', '-C', 'INPUT',
+            '-m', 'set', '!', '--match-set', 'admin_hosts', 'src',
+        ])
+
+    def test_match_set_requires_both_parameters(self):
+        for parameters in ({'match_set': 'admin_hosts'}, {'match_set_flags': 'src'}):
+            parameters['chain'] = 'INPUT'
+            set_module_args(parameters)
+            with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command') as run_command:
+                with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson):
+                    iptables.main()
+            self.assertEqual(run_command.call_count, 0)
+
+    def test_match_set_flags_rejects_invalid_choice(self):
+        set_module_args({'chain': 'INPUT', 'match_set': 'admin_hosts', 'match_set_flags': 'source'})
+        with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command') as run_command:
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson):
+                iptables.main()
+        self.assertEqual(run_command.call_count, 0)
+
+    def test_match_set_rejects_empty_name(self):
+        set_module_args({'chain': 'INPUT', 'match_set': '', 'match_set_flags': 'src'})
+        with patch.object(basic.AnsibleModule, 'run_command') as run_command:
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson):
+                iptables.main()
+        self.assertEqual(run_command.call_count, 0)
